name: GABBY SKELSEY
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Much of what makes us unhappy is unconscious and not easily accessed by easy explanations. I specialise in trauma and provide EMDR. I am a member of EMDR Australia.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Violeta Stolevska
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Violeta is WorkSafe, Medibank, Bupa, AHM,ARHM Recognised provider of Counselling Services. Violeta has been counselling clients in Australia and overseas for thirty years, providing individual, couple, family and group counselling to clients with a wide range of emotional, behavioural and relationship problems. These therapies may be helpful for anxiety, depression, relationship difficulties, stress, trauma, grief, anger, addictions, low self-esteem or life transitions.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Davina Storer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: My approach to counselling is one of collaboration and I approach my work with clients in a curious and non-judgemental way. My philosophy is to provide diversity-friendly therapy in a safe and supportive environment.

name: Susan Lackner
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Melbourne Specialist Relationship Counselling Clinic Specialist Relationship Therapists with Masters Degree in Couple Counselling and trained at Relationships Australia
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Terry Thomas - Goodier
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Terry is one of Melbourne’s leading couples counsellors in the South Eastern suburbs; specialising in relationships, couples counselling and parenting. As a therapist, she enjoys getting to know couples at a deeper level, providing truly empathetic support as she journeys with her clients through a variety of challenges they face, Providing them with real and practical tools to manage conflict, deepen their connection and strengthen friendship and intimacy. Key to the success of Terry’s work is relating to both partners with equity and empathy, helping them to repair, rebuild and connect.

name: Suzanne Sharp
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My approach is person centred which means that I listen closely to you, treat you as the expert in your life, and support you in finding new and more conscious choices. My work is informed by my mindfulness meditation practice, and my training in Emotion Focused Therapy and Art Therapy.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Thea Baker
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a counsellor and body-based (somatic) psychotherapist with special interests in all aspects women’s health, trauma (PTSD, C-PTSD) and couples / relationship therapy. I work collaboratively with my clients to find a place of healing and recovery. Now I combine that knowledge of anatomy and physiology with my research of how trauma is stored in the body using all sorts of creative approaches to therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Helen Telfer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Helen is a Clinical Counsellor. She is married and has a background in education, mentoring and community groups. Her past includes; secondary teaching, mentoring young adults/young mums, raising 4 children and living overseas.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy
